double invokes useState and useReducer i.note: Asserts that StrictMode double invokes lazy useState/useReducer initializers during render. A store's initial value is computed by the caller before createStore, outside of render, so there is no initializer for React to invoke.

should support editing useState hooks.note: A store is shared by every reader, not per-component Hook state, so it isn't editable through overrideHookState in v1 (isStateEditable is false and use(store) has no hook id). Store editing in DevTools is a follow-up.

should support editable useReducer hooks.note: A store is shared by every reader, not per-component Hook state, so it isn't editable through overrideHookState in v1 (isStateEditable is false and use(store) has no hook id). Store editing in DevTools is a follow-up.
